Subject: Post-call compliance recap + retention action items

Hi Carol (and team),

Thanks for carving time this morning — quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we’re aligned on the compliance/retention concerns you raised.

Summary notes:
- SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II attestation on 2026-04-12. I attached a short summary and control scope (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf). Full report is available under NDA — happy to share the most relevant sections.
- GDPR & DPA: We have a standard DPA that covers EU processing; we can scope additional requirements if needed.
- HIPAA / PHI: We support HIPAA workloads subject to a signed BAA. For hosted customers, we offer a BAA and additional configuration guardrails. For Private (VPC/on-prem), we can include the same clauses plus customer-managed keys.
- Data deletion SLA (what we discussed): default behavior is: soft-delete initiated immediately; data removed from primary hot storage within 30 days; backups are retained separately and purged on a 90-day default retention.
  - Enterprise option: we can offer shorter purge windows (30 days total) or longer archival retention (180/365 days) via contract.
- Logs & audit trails: Access/audit logs retained by default for 365 days for enterprise tiers (longer retention available on request).
- Backups: point-in-time snapshots are stored for the backup retention window in an immutable snapshot store. Backups are retained for 90 days by default; we can extend to 180 days if procurement requires.

Attachments included: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, retention-options-2026.csv, redwood-dataflow-diagram.png

Proposed next steps (action items):
1) Carol / Medisys: confirm whether you need a BAA for production and what your target deletion SLA is (30 / 90 / 180 days).
2) We’ll initiate the vendor security questionnaire (VSQ) — Vivek, can you own this? We’ll send the VSQ link and a short pre-filled packet.
3) If you want the SOC 2 report, please sign the NDA we’ll share; alternatively tell us the specific control areas you need evidence for and we’ll extract those sections.

If it helps I can generate a short one-page summary of options and costs for each retention tier.

Thanks — looking forward to the next steps.

Best,

1) VSQ kickoff: I’ll send the pre-filled VSQ link to Carol and Alan within 2 business hours and request completion within 3 business days. We’ll pre-populate evidence where possible to accelerate.

If Medisys requires a 30-day certified purge (no backups), we’ll need to scope an explicit contract clause and run it through legal; I’ll flag anything that changes RTO/RPO.
